data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Update guard contract to cover {create, update, DELETE}. Frozenset _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS keys remain {inbound_clean_label, outbound_create} but the actions they authorize are split: outbound_create authorized for {create}; inbound_clean_label authorized for {delete}. Per-leaf authorized-action map: _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_ACTIONS: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {'outbound_create': frozenset({'create'}), 'inbound_clean_label': frozenset({'delete'})}. Docstring documents this split. Add depends_on annotation: story-level dependency on draft-6 (7a75-53f5-ba82-44cd) for repair_property leaf-name stability — _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS cannot be finalized until all 9 leaf names are stable post-draft-2 AND repair_property leaf name confirmed post-draft-6.
